1.Finding the Midpoint of a Segment With Variable Coordinates?

Find the midpoint of the line segment with endpoints (2t,−3n) and (8t,7n).

E
Mon, Jul 7th @ 12:44 PM|Elapsed: 1:45Correct

Let (xm,ym) be the midpoint between (2t,−3n)⏟(x1,y1) and (8t,7n)⏟(x2,y2).

We use the midpoint formula as follows:

(xm,ym)=(x1+x22,y1+y22)=(2t+8t2,−3n+7n2)=(10t2,4n2)=(5t,2n).

We use the midpoint formula as follows: (xm,ym)=(x1+x22,y1+y22)=(a+5a2,5b+3b2)=(6a2,8b2)=(3a,4b)
